about_the_game:
The Genius Guide to the Wolfshead






Unleash Bedlam!




A hybrid Barbarian/Rogue class for

Pathfinder 1st Edition , the wolfshead is a master of stealth, cunning, and ferocity who emulates the predatory talents of the most dangerous hunters in nature, from falcons, to sharks, to wolves.
An excellent scout, ranged combatant, and hit-and-run skirmisher, the wolfshead is best when able to cull outlier foes from a group, or move in quickly amongst them to strike at vulnerable targets.
A wolfshead can be equally at home in the savage wilderness and the densest urban settlement. She is comfortable using her instincts and ease in dangerous environments to make her way through nearly any situation.
Written by veteran ttRPG designer, developer, and publisher Owen K.C. Stephens.

"
